parts:
Looks like you have some dummy variables as predictors. Remember, you can't include all dummy classes in the model, or you create perfect collinearity. Which classes are excluded, and do the excluded count for a sizeable share of all cases?

On Oct 31, 2017 10:47 AM, "S1995" <serit...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear All,

I'm fairly new at conducting SEM using Lavaan, specifically for mediation, in R. I'm having a bit of trouble actually getting a model computed because a Lavaan error message keeps popping up. Here is my code:

> AUDITmodel <- '  
+ 
+   # Outcome Model
+   AUDIT.Score ~ c1*Type.of.Funding+c2*Type.of.Degree+c3*RaceW+c4*RaceB+c5*RaceC+c6*RaceO+c7*AccomUCT+c8*AccomHome+c9*AccomOther+b1*Depression.Score
+ 
+   # Mediator Model
+   Depression.Score ~ a11*Type.of.Funding+a12*Type.of.Degree+a13*RaceW+a14*RaceB+a15*RaceC+a16*RaceO+a17*AccomUCT+a18*AccomHome+a19*AccomOther
+ 
+   # Indirect effects
+   Type.of.Funding_Depression := b1*a11
+   Type.of.Degree_Depression := b1*a12
+   RaceW_Depression := b1*a13
+   RaceB_Depression := b1*a14
+   RaceC_Depression := b1*a15
+   RaceO_Depression := b1*a16
+   AccomUCT_Depression := b1*a17
+   AccomHome_Depression := b1*a18
+   AccomOther_Depression := b1*a19
+   '
>   # SEM analysis
>   fitsemAUDIT <- sem(AUDITmodel,data = Main_Data_v3)
Error in lav_model_estimate(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: initial model-implied matrix (Sigma) is not positive definite;
  check your model and/or starting parameters.


Would really appreciate the help because I've tried almost everything to resolve this, and not even sure how I would fit starting parameters to correct this. Thank you!!
